title: Knowledge Check 6: Lessons 26–30
description: Pooled check over Lessons 26–30 of the Salesforce Architect series. Score 80% or higher to unlock the cert prep exam.

questions.question: Per the lesson “Enterprise REST API Design: Versioning, Pagination, Bulk, and Best Practices”, what is the central focus?
options: The design layer under every REST integration: how Salesforce versions its API, how to page through large result sets without breaking, when bulk writes beat synchronous calls, and the habits that keep an integration alive for years.
A history of the technology and its vendors
A review of unrelated productivity tools
A summary of corporate policy rules
questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: The design layer under every REST integration: how Salesforce versions its API, how to page through large result sets without breaking, when bulk writes beat synchronous calls, and the habits that keep an integration alive for years.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson’s guidance?
options: This lesson assumes you have already made that call and is not now designing the REST integration itself.
This lesson assumes you have already made that call and are now designing the REST integration itself.
The lesson argues this applies only in unrelated settings.
The lesson cautions against this in every real-world case.
questions.explanation: This lesson assumes you have already made that call and are now designing the REST integration itself.

questions.explanation: The lesson is centered on: The security layer under every integration: named credentials that keep endpoints and secrets out of code, JWT bearer for server-to-server auth, certificates for signing and mutual TLS, and IP allowlisting as the last fence that says who is even allowed to knock.
